result.summary: Round 2, lens owner_fit: 16 items, one for each market and execution score across the four candidates. 15 agree; each note says what I checked against the cleaned copies and how the score compares with the other ideas on the same yardstick. 1 disagree: market / 02-sai / competition_gap 3 -> 2. Reason: the market analyst's own rule for 01 ('a gap a competitor closes with one integration -> 2') applied the same way. AnyDress already offers a no-site link storefront with try-on, size from garment measurements and a 'DM to buy' button; TailorTalk takes orders in WhatsApp; the 'locally free' argument applied to 01 too and did not lift it to 3. Seven verbatim quotes are attached. Caveat stated in the note: no single competitor of 02 has the whole bundle, so 02's space is slightly more open than 01's, but in my view not by a full point. I did not read the other analysts' crossreview files before writing mine.
